== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Let the Wookiee Win (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-letthewookieewin-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-98-Let_The_Wookiee_Win.png]]) show the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Reveal the top 3 cards of Reserve Deck; place one in hand, and the others on bottom of Used Pile (in any order). STARTING: If your starting location was a non-[Special Edition] location, deploy from Reserve Deck an always [Immune to Alter] Effect and two <> sites with < 3 total [Light Side Force]. Place this Interrupt in hand.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_97</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
